notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}.
When Badgermole Cub enters, it triggers, earthbending Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.
